two readings of every declared COMMAND closure. The static screen (SILENT_CLOSURE_CHECK, UNRUNNABLE_CLOSURE_CHECK) covers the whole repository and consumes nothing, but it grades a declaration and a guard whose body is pass satisfies it. The live reading (UNREPORTING_CLOSURE_CHECK) runs the command and refuses silence; it is a verify check scoped to the active phase, because that is the set somebody is asked to close today. Both polarities of both readings are reached by fixtures.
